summary: Bulk migrate legacy project tags to new topic taxonomy and enable Slack tag-sync bot
description:
Issue summary:
We need an operational migration to normalize legacy JIRA project labels and Confluence page tags into the new Topic Taxonomy v2, plus deployment of a Slack tag-sync bot to keep channel topics aligned. This is a cross-tool admin task touching Jira, Confluence, and Slack automation.

Impact:
- Inconsistent topic taxonomy across ~180 projects and ~420 Confluence pages causes discovery issues for platform and product teams.
- Several Slack channels have outdated topic tags that block automated routing for onboarding and audit workflows.
- Manual fixes are time-consuming and error-prone; consolidated taxonomy will reduce noise for search and reporting.

Environment:
prod (org-wide)

Goals:
1) Create a safe, auditable migration plan to rename and remap legacy tags to Topic Taxonomy v2.
2) Run the migration in a non-destructive "alias" mode first, producing a report and approvals.
3) Deploy Slack tag-sync bot (read-only by default) that suggests topic changes and supports an approval gateway for bulk writes.
4) Provide rollback plan and monitoring for 72 hours post-migration.

Constraints:
- No downtime for Jira or Confluence.
- Changes must be reversible and accompanied by a confluence audit page.
- Must preserve historical tags as aliases for search for 90 days.
steps_to_execute: 1) Kickoff: sync with Docs and Security; create Confluence migration page with full mapping TSV.
2) Dry-run: run the migration tool in alias-only mode against a snapshot (non-destructive) and export results to migration-report.csv.
3) Review: stakeholder review (Docs, Platform, Security) and sign-off on migration-report.csv via Slack #platform-admins.
4) Approvals: get approval recorded in Jira ticket comments and attach to Confluence page. SLA: 48 hours for review.
5) Schedule: perform production write during low-traffic window (Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC).
6) Deploy Slack bot: enable read-only suggestion mode in prod with opt-in write permission gated by approval gateway per channel.
7) Execute migration: run write-mode migration with logging to S3 and trigger monitoring alerts (Datadog dashboard link in related_confluence_pages).
8) Post-run: produce reconciliation report, take manual spot checks on 20 high-value projects, and revert if >2% mismatch discovered.
9) Post-mortem: publish summary and metrics to Confluence and close ticket after 72-hour stabilization window.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Unintended tag renames that break saved filters and dashboards. Mitigation: Create alias mapping and preserve legacy tags for 90 days.
Risk: Slack bot making noisy suggestions. Mitigation: Start bot in suggestion-only mode; only enable auto-write after two-week observation and explicit approvals.
Risk: Permission errors during writes. Mitigation: Pre-provision a service account with scoped admin access and test it during dry-run.
Risk: Search regressions. Mitigation: Run internal search smoke tests and update documentation on query patterns.
Rollback: Restore from export manifest; alias mapping retained to revert visible names; known-state snapshots saved to S3 with timestamp.
